changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwnextofkin AS SELECT nok.id, nok.patient_id, nok.name, nok.relationship, nok.address, nok.email, nok.mobile_number, nok.telephone, nok.international_number, nok.landline_number, nok.created_by, nok.created_date, nok.last_modified_by, nok.last_modified_date FROM public.next_of_kin nok;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwnextofkin TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwnextofkin FROM report_user;
